summary: Frontend hooks and Settings page wiring for running settlement and fetching diagnostics/metrics were added/updated, but the diff evidence does not show the required backend Candid methods or the actual settlement/metrics computation logic being implemented. Several unrelated frontend route/layout/about/parlay/edge-board changes appear in the diff summary but were not requested.

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement backend settlement engine APIs: runSettlementNow (admin-only), getSettlementDiagnostics (admin-only), getSettlementMetrics (authenticated), with complete SettlementDiagnostics/SettlementMetrics shapes and non-trapping behavior for authorized callers.
missing_requirements.reason: backend/main.mo is truncated and only shows type definitions being added (SettlementDiagnostics/SettlementMetrics). There is no visible evidence in the diff summary of the Candid-exposed methods (runSettlementNow/getSettlementDiagnostics/getSettlementMetrics) being implemented or of the admin/authenticated authorization behavior and error messages.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add backend logic to settle eligible predictions in settleablePredictions during runSettlementNow(), update diagnostics counters/timestamps (attempt/success/failure), deterministically set outcome/resultValue, and succeed with numSettledInLastRun=0 when nothing eligible exists.
missing_requirements.reason: No visible code in the provided backend diff excerpt shows iteration over settleablePredictions, eligibility checks (active + completed), deterministic outcome assignment, or diagnostics updates; the backend diff is truncated before any such logic is shown.

missing_requirements.requirement: Compute settlement metrics in getSettlementMetrics() from settled predictions: totalSettled/totalWon/totalLost/totalPush, sevenDayWinRate (0..1), totalROI (safe defaults), returning zeros when none settled.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows the SettlementMetrics type definition in backend/main.mo, but does not show any backend implementation that calculates these metrics from settleablePredictions or enforces safe numeric behavior (no NaN/Infinity).

missing_requirements.requirement: Update frontend settlement flow end-to-end: admin Settings action triggers runSettlementNow and on success updates diagnostics and metrics via React Query invalidation; show English error messages and avoid stuck loading.
missing_requirements.reason: Hooks for runSettlementNow and queries are updated and include invalidations, but SettingsPage.tsx is truncated before showing the actual admin-only settlement UI section using these hooks (button wiring/loading states/error handling). The build request also requires end-to-end use of new backend methods; backend implementation evidence is missing.
